seo.title: Pressure Vessel Volume Calculator - ASME Heads
seo.description: Pressure Vessel Volume Calculator — Calculate internal volume of horizontal/vertical pressure vessels including cylindrical shell and 2:1 elliptical heads with instant results & multiple unit support.

formula.explanation: Shell volume = π(D/2)² × L. Two 2:1 elliptical heads ≈ 2 × (πD³/24) = πD³/12. ×1000 converts m³ to liters.

content.introduction: Calculate total internal volume of a pressure vessel with cylindrical shell and two 2:1 elliptical heads (standard ASME dish). For other head types: hemispherical heads use πD³/6 each; flat heads use 0 additional volume.

example.description: 2m × 5m shell (15,708 L) + two heads (~2,094 L) = ~17,800 liters total.

faq.a: Hemispherical: each head = πD³/12; 2:1 Elliptical (standard ASME): each head ≈ πD³/24; Flat: ~0. This calculator uses 2:1 elliptical heads × 2.

faq.q: How much volume is in the heads vs shell?
faq.a: For a 2:1 vessel (L = 2.5D), heads are about 15-20% of total volume. For tall columns, head volume is negligible.
